content_zh:
早会上，师主任轻飘飘一句话立刻激起轩然大波，别说新人了，就连老医生都对胡悦刮目相看，“小胡，可以呀，这十年来你可是师主任第一个带出门诊的住院医，有本事，有本事。”
年轻的男师傅带着女徒弟，如果还给了特权待遇，很容易让人想歪，不过师主任和胡悦不在其中，大家是真心钦佩胡悦的手段，现在大家倒觉得她以研究生学历进到十六院很合理：她的后门都能搞定师主任，还有什么事情办不成？
这毕竟是一门技术工种，只要手底下活硬，终究是好出头。他们这群小医生最多还只是割割双眼皮，胡悦就亲自上阵去塞假体了，现在眼看走上住院总的坦途，同事也没什么好恨的，大家业务又不怎么交叉，最多是希望她在繁重的工作中自行掉队，半路退出这激烈的竞争。
别人看她，是已经青云直上，只有胡悦自己知道师主任今天为什么大发善心，她揉揉眼——昨天加班到十二点，直到又一次跳电，需要师主任的卡重刷登录这才回家，六点多草草收拾一番就又过来，余下的病历整理工作仍繁重，男患者的整理也才刚开个头，今天跟一天门诊，明天说不定还要上手术台，后天解同和来的时候，她怎么回答？在师主任手下做事，他的这十八般手段可真不怎么好尝。
“好的。”是这个理，但也绝不可能拒绝师主任的安排，对住院医来说，跟门诊也是工作中相当重要甚至是最重要的一环，和病人的沟通，问诊的流程，对病情——在19层是求美者的诉求，这都得靠大量的练习和模仿。尤其她对于整形美容算是初来乍到，之前也没跟过门诊，自然不可能放弃这学习的机会。“谢谢老师给我这个机会。”
嘴是甜。
沉默的看客们眼神在师主任和胡悦之间转来转去，各自若有所悟：要不胡悦能上进得这么快呢，是有些过人之处，自己多少得学着点……/别人家的小鬼的确是懂事的，自己的几个住院医比起来就有些粗野了……
但师主任和胡住院之间交换的眼神，可就全不是那回事了。师主任的眉毛扬起来了一点：自己的一计没能让敌军吃惊，有些出乎他的意料，不过，作为主任医师，他依旧占尽优势，也不会这么简单就丢弃自己的优越感。
两人的眼神相逢，师主任多少带了些探询，胡悦心里其实没什么底，但也露出镇定的微笑，不叫他看清虚实。“师老师，走吗？”
无关职位尊卑，这一次两个人的战争，旁观者怎么看，都是胡悦又占了点上风。
“师医生你好。”
“你好，有什么问题？”
如果是一般的科室，接诊问诊是有明确流程的，对大部分医生来说，门诊第一步避着眼睛都能走完：主诉症状明晰的，按照该病常用方案处置，不明确的那就再做后续检查，病因不明的高热什么的比较磨人，先给退热治疗，后续再做检查，推理什么的，那都是看着报告去做的事情。十九层算是医院里的一个特例——很多求美者走进诊室的时候实际上并不知道自己需要什么，她们只有一个模糊的念头，有时候还往往都是错的。
“我想做鼻综合。”
这个是今天一早的主旋律，师主任算是叫号比较快的——相对而言，十九层这边还有个特点，就是每个号的时间都较长。一早上6个号里五个都是想来做鼻综合的。师主任瞟了求美者一眼，“为什么想做鼻综合？”
“我的鼻子太矮了，山根和鼻基底都有点塌陷。和眉骨配合不好……”
才跟了几个号，胡悦就开始发现求美者各自的类型了——这里是不太会有家境极困难，只是有病不得不和医院打交道的患者的，过来整容的可以粗略地分为新手和老手：新手年纪往往轻，有时候还是长辈带着来的，自己没什么主见，对价格也敏感，只知道自己的鼻子太塌、鼻头太大……但老手就可以精准地说出山根、鼻基底、鼻翼和鼻中隔这种专业术语，如果注意观察——有些甚至不需要很注意，可以看出来，一般她们的下巴、太阳穴甚至是苹果肌、双眼皮，都有整形过的痕迹。
至于这满口的专业术语是对是错……
“胡言乱语。”让胡悦可堪告慰的一点是，师霁对病人也是毫不客气，“鼻基底凹陷是猪腰子脸，你的山根是有点低，但远远没到塌陷的地步，想隆鼻就直接说想隆鼻，谁告诉你你得做鼻综合？”

content_en:
At the morning meeting, the division director's light words immediately caused an uproar. Not to mention the newcomers, even the old doctors looked at Hu Yue with admiration, "Xiao Hu, it's okay. In the past ten years, you are the first resident doctor that the division director has brought out of the outpatient clinic. You are capable and capable."
If a young male master and a female apprentice were given privileged treatment, it would be easy to make people think wrongly, but the division director and Hu Yue were not among them. Everyone really admired Hu Yue's methods. Now everyone thinks it is reasonable for her to enter the 16th Academy with a graduate degree: she can handle the division director through the back door, what else can't be done?
After all, this is a technical job, and as long as you work hard, it will be easy to get ahead. At most, their group of young doctors only performed double eyelid surgery, but Hu Yue personally went to the battle to insert prostheses. Now she is on a smooth road to hospitalization. Her colleagues have nothing to hate, and their business does not overlap much. At most, they hope that she will fall behind in the heavy work and withdraw from this fierce competition halfway.
Others saw that she was already on the rise. Only Hu Yue knew why the division director was so kind today. She rubbed her eyes - she worked overtime until 12 o'clock yesterday, until another power outage required the division director's card to log in again. Then she came back after six o'clock. Working under the division director, his various methods are not very pleasant.
"Okay." This is the reason, but it is absolutely impossible to refuse the arrangement of the division director. For residents, outpatient service is also a very important or even the most important part of the work. Communication with patients, consultation process, and understanding of the condition - on the 19th floor, it is the appeal of the beauty seeker, all of which require a lot of practice and imitation. Especially since she is new to plastic surgery and has never been to a clinic before, she naturally cannot give up this opportunity to learn. "Thank you teacher for giving me this opportunity."
The mouth is sweet.
The silent spectators looked back and forth between the division director and Hu Yue, and each of them seemed to have some realization: Hu Yue could advance so quickly, because he had something special about him, and he had to learn from it.../Other people's brats are indeed sensible, but compared to several of their own residents, they are a bit rough...
But the look exchanged between the division director and Hu Zinbin was completely different from that. The division director's eyebrows rose a little: his plan failed to surprise the enemy, which was somewhat beyond his expectation. However, as the chief physician, he still had the advantage, and he would not give up his sense of superiority so easily.
The two people's eyes met, and the division director was somewhat inquisitive. Hu Yue actually didn't have any confidence in his heart, but he also showed a calm smile to prevent him from seeing clearly the truth. "Teacher Shi, are you leaving?"
It has nothing to do with position. In this war between two people, no matter what the onlookers think, Hu Yue has the upper hand again.
"Hello, doctor."
"Hello, what's the problem?"
If it is a general department, there is a clear process for admission and consultation. For most doctors, the first step of the outpatient clinic can be completed without looking at the eyes: if the main symptoms are clear, they will be dealt with according to the common plans for the disease. If the symptoms are not clear, follow-up examinations will be performed. For high fever with unknown causes, which is more troublesome, antipyretic treatment will be given first, followed by examinations, reasoning, etc., which are all done based on the reports. The 19th floor is a special case in the hospital - many beauty seekers don't actually know what they need when they walk into the clinic. They only have a vague idea, and sometimes it is often wrong.
"I want to do rhinoplasty."
This was the main theme this morning. The division director called the number relatively quickly - relatively speaking, another feature of the 19th floor was that each number took a longer time. Six numbers a morningFive of them wanted to undergo rhinoplasty. The teacher glanced at the beauty seeker and said, "Why do you want to do rhinoplasty?"
"My nose is too short, and the root and base of my nose are a bit sunken. It doesn't work well with the brow bone..."
After only a few follow-ups, Hu Yue began to discover the different types of beauty seekers - here there are very few patients who come from extremely difficult families and have to deal with the hospital due to illness. People who come for plastic surgery can be roughly divided into novices and veterans: novices are often young, and sometimes they are brought here by their elders. They have no independent opinions and have no idea about the price. Sensitive, they only know that their nose is too flat and the tip of the nose is too big... But experienced people can accurately name the professional terms such as root, nose base, nose wing and nasal septum. If you pay attention to it - some don't even need to pay much attention, you can see that generally their chin, temples, even apple muscles and double eyelids have traces of plastic surgery.
As for whether this full of professional terminology is right or wrong...
"Nonsense." What comforts Hu Yueke is that Shi Ji is also rude to patients, "A sunken nose base is a pig kidney face. Your base is a bit low, but it is far from collapsed. If you want a rhinoplasty, just say you want a rhinoplasty. Who told you that you need rhinoplasty?"
